name: Generic Exterior Sensing Decision Demo
description: Deterministic synthetic reference profile for the MultiSens v0.6 decision-support workflow. Reference sensor ids (front_rgb, rear_rgb, sim_thermal, sim_depth) represent an exterior front/rear camera plus simulated thermal/depth sensing space - front_rgb and rear_rgb are separate physical RGB camera positions, never merged just because they share a modality. SYNTHETIC DATA - demonstrates functionality only, not a claim about real camera performance, physical or simulated. See examples/profiles/README.md.

requirements.name: Basic presence detection
requirements.description: A loose accuracy bar - the easiest requirement in this demo, satisfied by a single camera alone.

requirements.name: Standard presence detection
requirements.description: A moderate accuracy bar - needs more than a single weak camera to satisfy.

requirements.name: Advanced presence detection
requirements.description: A stricter accuracy bar - the point where a genuinely different sensing modality (thermal) starts to matter more than a second ordinary camera.

requirements.name: Strict presence detection
requirements.description: The strictest accuracy bar in this demo - only the fullest well-chosen sensor combination reaches it.
